summary_en: MITANI CORPORATION authorized acquisition of up to 6.4 million shares (7.49% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥19.2 billion on November 12, 2026, through a single-day acquisition on November 13, 2026, responding to sell requests from existing shareholders as part of shareholder returns and capital management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, the Board of Directors of MITANI CORPORATION resolved to establish a new treasury stock acquisition program. The company will acquire up to 6.4 million ordinary shares, representing 7.49% of outstanding shares (calculated from 6,400,000 divided by 85,445,370), for a maximum of ¥19.2 billion. The acquisition period is set for a single day: November 13, 2026.

The authorization responds to sell requests from several existing shareholders. The company characterized the acquisition as part of shareholder returns and capital management policy. As of November 12, 2026, the company held 5.554 million treasury shares against a total issued capital of 85.445 million shares (excluding treasury stock).
